Name: Genshin Impact Plushies - Fontaine
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
I'm back and this time with Fontaine! And yes there are two Furinas because she's my second favorite archon and she deserves all the love in the world okay-
[line]
[b][i][color=#a4c2f4][size=3]Features[/size][/color][/i][/b]
💧 All [b]13(+1) playable characters from Fontaine[/b] [size=1](as of Luna VI)[/size], added as [b]new furniture[/b] placeable both indoors and outdoors
⚖️ [b]Characters included, in order of release:[/b] Furina, Lyney, Lynette, Freminet, Neuvillette, Wriothesley, Charlotte, Navia, Chevreuse, Clorinde, Sigewinne, Emilie and Escoffier
💧 Easily find them in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39884]Genshin Plushies Catalogue[/url]﻿!
⚖️ If you don't have my catalogue, they'll be in the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b] [size=1](search for 'Genshin' or 'Fontaine' if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url])[/size]
💧 Consolation for when you want a character but the gacha isn't kind to you - at least you can have them in a different game!
⚖️ [b]i18n compatible![/b] Includes English and Spanish as of 1.0.0
[line]
[b][i][color=#a4c2f4][size=3]Future Plans[/size][/color][/i][/b]
💧 This will be updated for as long as I'm still into both Stardew and Genshin [size=1](aka a very, [i]very[/i] long time, because I've invested way too much on both to let go)[/size], so [b]new characters will be added as they're released![/b]
⚖️ [b]Continuing the series![/b]
   ✧ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38334]Mondstadt[/url]
   ✧ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39263]Liyue[/url]
   ✧ Inazuma
   ✧ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46223]Sumeru[/url]
   ✧ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38492]Fontaine[/url] - you're here!
   ✧ ﻿Natlan
   ✧ Nod-Krai
   ✧ Other Factions [size=1](Harbingers, Mages and the Twins will be here - including Arlecchino!)[/size]
   ✧ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39884]Paimon Catalogue[/url]
[line]
[b][i][color=#a4c2f4][size=3]Mods in the Pictures[/size][/color][/i][/b]
💧 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural ReShade[/url]
⚖️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interiors[/url]
💧 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27122]MolaMole's Wallpaper and Flooring[/url]
⚖️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30602]Guxelbit's Walls and Floors[/url]
💧 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28043]Kisaa's Tiny Rooms Pack[/url]

Once again! I highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url]! Lyney gave you a Rainbow Rose in Genshin so it's only fair you give him a whole farm of Rainbow Roses, don't you think? Because I do. I'll do anything for that man.
[line]
[color=#c9daf8][size=2]"We now turn to the ✨Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale✨" *insert dancing Neuvillette*[/size][/color]
[line]
